utterances.speaker: JUDGE VOHRAH

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VOHRAH
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, we are here this morning for the initial appearance of the accused pursuant to Rule 62 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence upon their transfer to the Tribunal. The purpose of this initial appearance is for me to be assured that you understand the contents of the indictment and to find out if you wish to make your plea today, although you have a 30-day period in which to do so. Now, I am very pleased to see you, Ms. Residovic. You've appeared before me several times before, and I know you're fully conversant with the Rules and Procedure of this Tribunal, and I trust Mr. Crnalic and Mr. Ibrisimovic are also fully conversant with the rules of this Tribunal. I must say I am here acting in my capacity as duty Judge pursuant to Rule 28. I should also inform you that this case has already been assigned by order of the President of 7 August 2001 to Trial Chamber II. Now, Mrs. Residovic, you do know that the common practice in this Court is not for the indictment to be read out to the accused if he's represented by counsel, but if your client would like the indictment read out, we will do so.
